_readme: Per-client repos ONLY (ETL + config). Shared frontend/backend are in knowledge/platform-repos.json. KW = KnitWell Group (brands: Loft, Ann Taylor / Ann). Config repo is per-brand; this entry covers Loft (loft-configs). Add sibling entries here if/when Ann-specific config repo details are confirmed.

loft.note: Branch name is 'planning_strategy' (underscore) — do not confuse with similar-sounding names.

oci.note: No separate 'Upgrade' bucket exists — only staging and prod. Ticket SUP-2132 comments referred to 'Upgrade' as distinct from 'Prod', but config is byte-identical between the two live buckets and the repo (verified 2026-08-06), so 'Upgrade' likely shares the prod config source. Confirm with team if this mapping is wrong.
